integrity: No independent audit or validation has been performed. The stated analytic proof covers all integer parameters in the theorem, conditional on its verifiable algebraic steps. The prior finite-table rank prediction is explicitly credited to Kimmerling.
scientific_limitations: The rank and kernel theorem applies only to unweighted Kulli path windmills with at least three path blades of length at least two, not to one/two blades or finite-time or instantaneous mixing. The source dissertation full PDF could not be completely inspected; an indexed primary Section 5.1.3 excerpt identifies the b>=3 rank case as conjectural, leaving some unseen-literature risk. Computational tests confirm examples but do not prove the infinite claim.
title: Exact kernel of quantum average mixing on Kulli path windmills
